summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Master Log Sheet system for production management (Shoot Logs). Backend APIs 100% functional with all CRUD operations, filtering, sorting, grouping, and export working perfectly. Frontend UI displays correctly with 28-column schema, color coding, and most interactive features working. Minor modal overlay issues with some dropdown interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay intercepts clicks on some dropdown elements and buttons
ui_bugs.selector: Filter dialog dropdowns and some modal interactions
ui_bugs.details: Modal overlay blocks some interactions. Force=True clicks work but user experience could be improved with z-index adjustments.
